summary: Frontend nav-reorganization smoke (iter 279d) on Pulse Operations → Staffing. Logged in as pulse.admin.test@pulsefitness.com (Pulse Master Admin), entered /pulse, validated top Operations tab strip and the nested Staffing group/sub-tab bars. All acceptance criteria pass.

issues: A secondary sub-tab bar is rendered with a single 'Team Clock' pill for managers. Functionally fine (Team Clock renders), but the lone pill is visually redundant — consider hiding the sub-tab bar when only one child exists, OR rendering as a leaf group (like Payroll/Expenses). Minor polish only.

verified_acceptance_criteria: Top Operations strip has NO 'Expenses' tab (only Dashboard, Equipment, Faults, Check Sheets, AI Diagnosis, Documents, Staffing, Reports, Suppliers, Gym Layout).
Staffing GROUP bar order matches exactly: Dashboard, People, Rota, Time Clock, Performance, Payroll, Expenses, Comms, Ops · Forms, Rules.
People → sub-tabs Staff + HR. HR view shows 'Manage job roles' button.
Rota → sub-tabs Schedule, Templates, Time Off, Shift Market, Live Floor, AI Rota — all render content without error.
Performance → sub-tabs Overview + AI Insights — both render.
Comms → sub-tabs Announcements + Handover Diary — both render.
Expenses (inside Staffing, right after Payroll) renders DeskExpenses cockpit — 'Approvals' and 'Reports' text confirmed in DOM.
Ops · Forms and Rules render directly with NO secondary sub-tab bar.
Payroll renders the export-CSV card directly (no sub-tabs).
0 page errors / 0 React exceptions captured during the full sweep. (CSP-blocked emergent-main.js + posthog.js + cloudflareinsights are pre-existing analytics warnings unrelated to this change.)
action_items: (Optional polish) Suppress the secondary sub-tab bar when an active group has only one visible child (e.g., manager-only Time Clock → single 'Team Clock' pill). Either render as a leaf or hide the row.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffingConsole.js is 700+ lines and includes many tab components inline (RotaTab, StaffTab, LeaveTab, MarketTab, PerformanceTab, PayrollTab, LiveFloorTab, AnnouncementsTab, RulesTab, AIInsightsTab). Consider splitting per-tab modules into the existing /staffing/ folder pattern (TimeClockTab/CommsTab/etc. already are) to keep the orchestrator file <300 lines.

Group config GROUPS_ALL hard-codes Time Clock children as Team Clock (MGR) + My Clock (staff only). For a manager-only view the child list collapses to 1 — surfacing a secondary bar with a single pill is visually noisy. Consider auto-flattening to a leaf when filtered children.length === 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav reorg validated end-to-end at https://admin-setup-portal.preview.emergentagent.com/pulse → Staffing. data-testids in StaffingConsole.js (staffing-tabs, staffing-tab-<id>, staffing-subtabs, staffing-subtab-<leaf>) are stable. Only minor UX nit is the single-child sub-tab bar in Time Clock — not blocking.
rca of the issue: n/a — feature verification only, no bug investigation.
